title: Life After Coal
metaDescription: Life After Coal: support for miners and their families in Czech and Polish Silesia, in one place.
ogTitle: Život po uhlí · Życie po węglu · Life After Coal
ogDescription: Všechna podpora pro horníky a jejich rodiny na českém i polském Slezsku · Całe wsparcie dla górników i ich rodzin na Śląsku · Every support programme for miners in Silesia.

CHECK WHAT YOU CAN GET → PROGRAMMES Photo: Tadeáš Bednarz · CC BY-SA 4.0 44 IN POLAND 31 IN CZECHIA 1 PLACE TO FIND THEM 75 programmes and local measures, checked on 14 Nov 2026 WHAT DO YOU NEED? 💰 Money after leaving 🕰 Pension 🦺 New job 🛠 Training 🏪 Own business 🏠 Family and community 💬 Advice 📍 Official portals NEXT DEADLINES NOV 2026 (INDICATIVE) Decision on the 10.19 outplacement call (PLN 177.8m); chosen projects then start recruiting DEC 2026 OKD starts filling the ČSM-Jih shafts; ČSM-Sever follows in Jan-Feb 2027 31 DECEMBER 2026 Last day to apply for the Úvěr Transformace interest-free business loan All dates → DID YOU KNOW? 14 KM Under Zabrze and Chorzów runs a drainage adit over 14 km long, dug between 1799 and 1863, the longest in European coal mining. Today you can ride a boat through part of it at the Queen Louise Adit in Zabrze. Source ↗ UNESCO The historic lead-silver-zinc mine in Tarnowskie Góry and its underground water system have been on the UNESCO World Heritage List since 2017. Source ↗ Carbide lamps made light from acetylene gas: water dripped onto calcium carbide. An open flame is dangerous in gassy coal mines, so miners there used enclosed safety lamps until electric cap lamps took over. Source ↗ Photo: Jim Heaphy (Cullen328) · CC BY-SA 4.0 More mining facts → YOU'RE NOT ALONE IN THIS Leaving the mine is hard. Talk to someone about money, your pension, a new job or how you feel. ☎ NEED TO TALK? ASK A QUESTION IN YOUR OWN WORDS Our assistant answers only from the programmes on this site and shows where each answer comes from. ASK ABOUT YOUR NEXT STEP → WHY THIS SITE EXISTS 1 No single channel covers company benefits, state benefits, EU projects and labour-office help. Each owner publishes only its own piece. 2 About one third of the ~900 people who left the ČSM mine had found work by early 2026, mostly at lower pay. 3 In the Karviná district there are about 20 job seekers for every vacancy.
